classification.difficultyReason: Read and compare ordinates on supplied sine and cosine graphs, including equal values and negative values.

content.prompt:
Consider the graphs of $y=\cos x$ and $y=\sin x$ on the same axis.

Decide whether the following statements are true or false.

spec.description: Two black labelled curves on common rectangular axes and a fine grey grid. The graph extends beyond the plotted domain to provide the source margins. Increased width preserves readable labels and the fine grid.
spec.mathematics: y=sin x and y=cos x for 0<=x<=360 degrees. Minor grid steps 10 degrees and 0.1; major grid steps 45 degrees and 0.5. Labelled horizontal values 0, 90, 180, 270, 360 degrees; labelled vertical values -1 and 1.
spec.answerVisibility: Both curves, their labels, axes and grid remain visible in student and answer editions.

answer.worked: On the sine graph, the ordinate at $60^{\circ}$ is positive and the ordinate at $200^{\circ}$ is negative. Hence $\sin60^{\circ}>\sin200^{\circ}$.
The sine graph is above the axis at $100^{\circ}$ and below it at $300^{\circ}$. Thus $\sin100^{\circ}>\sin300^{\circ}$.
On the sine graph, the ordinate at $135^{\circ}$ is higher than the ordinate at $10^{\circ}$. Thus $\sin135^{\circ}>\sin10^{\circ}$.
The sine graph has the same ordinate at $200^{\circ}$ and $340^{\circ}$, so $\sin200^{\circ}=\sin340^{\circ}$.
The cosine graph is positive at $70^{\circ}$ and negative at $125^{\circ}$. Thus $\cos70^{\circ}>\cos125^{\circ}$.
The cosine graph is positive at $315^{\circ}$ and negative at $135^{\circ}$. Hence $\cos315^{\circ}>\cos135^{\circ}$.
The cosine graph has the same ordinate at $310^{\circ}$ and $50^{\circ}$. Hence $\cos310^{\circ}=\cos50^{\circ}$.
Both ordinates are negative, but the cosine graph at $95^{\circ}$ is closer to zero and higher than at $260^{\circ}$. Hence $\cos95^{\circ}>\cos260^{\circ}$.
The sine graph at $90^{\circ}$ and the cosine graph at $360^{\circ}$ both have ordinate $1$.
At $180^{\circ}$, the cosine graph has ordinate $-1$ and the sine graph has ordinate $0$. These values are unequal.
The sine graph at $210^{\circ}$ has ordinate $-0.5$, which is higher than its ordinate near $-1$ at $285^{\circ}$. Hence $\sin210^{\circ}>\sin285^{\circ}$.
The cosine graph is positive at $15^{\circ}$ and negative at $115^{\circ}$. Hence $\cos15^{\circ}>\cos115^{\circ}$.
